scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: Environmental cradle-to-production-release LCA of one specified, undyed, uncoated, nonabsorbable polypropylene monofilament suture, supplied without a needle, dry in its sterile barrier after gamma irradiation. The reference is a physical supplied article, not an amount of treatment or a claim of equivalent clinical performance. Record actual manufacturing, QA, packaging and external treatment resources; this PCR gives no clinical, surgical or sterilisation operating instructions or parameters.

CPC 3.0 identifies 35290 through HS 2022 heading 30.06. Chapter 30 note 4(a) positively identifies sterile suture materials there; 35279 corresponds to 30.05 dressings. This narrow suture scope does not cover the entire residual category. Exclude medicaments, blood products, vaccines, wadding and dressings, dental/bone cements, first-aid kits, ostomy articles, free surgical needles, syringes, catheters and other instruments/appliances. Regulatory designation as a medical device does not itself assign CPC 48150. Nonsterile industrial polypropylene filament is an input or intermediate, not the supplied reference article. Sources: `un-cpc3-2025`; `wco-hs2022-ch30`.

The FDA applicant case establishes an actual sterile single-use polypropylene monofilament article offered without a needle, including an undyed option and gamma treatment; its packaging table identifies aluminium foil and polyester. The historical EPO patent supports manufacturing stage identification, not a current factory recipe or environmental intensity. Its ethylene-oxide example is not the gamma route selected here. The FDA testing paragraph's reference to an absorbable suture conflicts with its nonabsorbable device description; that paragraph supplies neither identity nor performance assumptions here. Sources: `fda-k993997-suture`; `epo-0800834-suture`. The FDA summary does not explicitly affirm uncoated supply; uncoated remains the bounded PCR specification to verify through actual SKU/BOM before concrete dataset use. en_description.text_excerpt: The single terminal output is undyed, uncoated, nonabsorbable, needle-free, dry-packed and gamma-sterilised, with first quality release complete. Q counts unique positive net thread mass once, including the newly released portion still in finished stock. Packaging remains in burdens but is outside thread mass. Reaccepted returns and closing finished stock are not extra new production. The verified native name is Health and Medical Supplies / 卫生材料及医药用品, with medical-consumable synonyms. It is a Product flow with only reference Mass kg factor1; no additional name-property, CAS, form/grade, route or supply-geography qualifier is provided. Its complete comment discusses emergency medicine/medical-supply stockpiles, home-care supplies and DME; it specifies no composition, needle, coating, sterility route or provider quantity for this suture. This PCR conditionally selects only the one PP needle-free suture member with all external primary evidence and actual SKU/release qualifiers; never aggregate the different supplies in that comment into one reference or treat the family UUID as sterility, certification, efficacy or supplier proof.
